topic: How to Read a Commercial Rent Roll
caption:
Lesson 20 — How to Read a Commercial Rent Roll

A rent roll is the centralized list of tenants, units, lease terms, rents, and tenant obligations. It’s one of the first documents to request when evaluating or underwriting a commercial property in Chester or Montgomery County. A clear rent roll helps you verify income, identify upcoming expirations, confirm which expenses tenants reimburse, and spot tenant concentration risk. When reviewing a rent roll, match rents to deposits, check lease end dates and renewal options, confirm expense allocations, and note any concessions or free rent.
